@graph.name: Plant spaceflight alternative splicing analysis
@graph.description: rMATS-based differential splicing analysis of NASA OSDR plant RNA-seq data with ML and ontology integration. 7 Arabidopsis thaliana studies (OSD-314, OSD-120, OSD-37, OSD-678, OSD-658, OSD-476, OSD-251) + 1 Brassica rapa study (OSD-59). 199 samples, ~100,000 events, 93 recurrent genes, AT4G17310 in 4 studies.
